key_insight: Decoupling novelty-seeking exploration from final optimization lets RLVR discover new reasoning strategies without sacrificing model quality.
engineering_relevance: For RL systems, this suggests a safer way to scale exploration: use separate explorer policies and distill only correct, high-quality trajectories into the student.
method: Train explorer policy/policies with a novelty bonus in the reward.
Filter trajectories for correctness and quality.
Distill accepted trajectories into a student policy trained without novelty, then repeat over multiple rounds.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, with ExpDis outperforming DAPO at the same wall-clock budget and improving pass@k scaling.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable filtering of explorer trajectories, which can become a bottleneck if correctness or quality checks are noisy or expensive.
paper_title: Decoupling Exploration from Optimization in RLVR
